contexts.text: That charity and faith are rare, Signified.
Rarely with man, in the world. AC 7055:3.
Faith is now so rare within the Church...
Love truly conjugial is now so rare...
Rarely if ever does a chaste wife not love her husband.
Most rarely, if ever, can those in sensuous lumen be in good and truth...
I will make a man rare beyond pure gold (). A man who is rare = those who are in truths. AE 280:3. AE 304:5. ( = intelligence scarcely any longer. AE 400:4.)
That the affection of spiritual truth and the derivative wisdom will cease, is signified by, Man shall be left rare (). AE 304:4.
Let their men become rare, slain of death () = that the affection of truth and the derivative wisdom is null.
